name: 狄金森
summary: 狄金森，马萨诸塞州阿默斯特人，美国抒情诗人（Britannica：American lyric poet）。'wrote nearly 1,800 poems, but only 10 were published in her lifetime, all anonymously'（写了近1800首诗，生前仅10首匿名发表——Britannica）。赞美诗体诗节、斜韵、破折号与首字母大写（Britannica：hymn-like verse forms, slant rhymes, and her liberal use of dashes and capitalization）。主题：死亡、不朽、自然、信仰与怀疑、孤立（Britannica：themes include death, immortality, nature, faith and doubt, and isolation）。名诗《因为我不能停下等待死神》《希望是有羽毛的东西》（Britannica：famous poems include 'Because I could not stop for Death' and 'Hope is the thing with feathers'）。'隐居渐深，her full greatness was only recognized well into the 20th century'（20世纪才充分认可其伟大——Britannica）。1886年5月15日卒于阿默斯特（Britannica）。

timeline.text: 生于阿默斯特，卒于同地（Britannica：Born and died in Amherst, Massachusetts）。
阿默斯特学院（Britannica：Educated at Amherst Academy）——'she excelled in composition, Latin, and science, and assembled a botanical herbarium'（作文拉丁科学优异、植物标本册——Britannica）；Mount Holyoke 短期（Britannica）。

'与未明'Master'通信及'与法官洛德恋情'（Britannica：intense relationships, including correspondence with an unidentified 'Master' and a later romance with judge Otis Phillips Lord）；隐居渐深（Britannica：She lived increasingly in seclusion）。
卒于阿默斯特（Britannica：Born and died in Amherst）；妹妹 Lavinia 发现诗稿（通说待核）。

style: 赞美诗体诗节、斜韵、破折号与首字母大写（Britannica：hymn-like verse forms, slant rhymes, and her liberal use of dashes and capitalization）。
格言式简练与意象的突变（通说）。
'定义诗'（《希望是有羽毛的东西》——'Hope is the thing with feathers'——原文，公有领域）。
status: Britannica 定位狄金森为'美国抒情诗人'，生前仅发表10首匿名诗（Britannica：only 10 were published in her lifetime, all anonymously）——20世纪才充分认可（Britannica：her full greatness was only recognized well into the 20th century）。'狄金森式'的破折号与斜韵成为现代诗歌的形式遗产（通说待核）。
